items.title: The base change comparison map is an isomorphism under Tor independence
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the condition under which the comparison map between two ways of forming a base changed complex is an isomorphism, and the proof is a 15-line argument built on the choice of a free resolution. It resolves the base ring over the ground ring by free modules, uses the Tor independence hypothesis to see that tensoring the resolution with the algebra still gives a free resolution, and then compares the four total complexes appearing in the chain by the general construction of the derived tensor product. Each isomorphism in the displayed chain is justified by a named construction, and the chain is written out in full.
